answer: The quartz multiplier is published, charged in walnut, and reef lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 7 for each identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, because the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 4324 identities would post 2734 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
